uncited: **Color Pass:** Draw each stroke colored and textured with an opacity map.
**Overlap Pass:** Draw each stroke white and textured with the same opacity maps used in the Color Pass.
Alpha blend with transparency $0 < \alpha \le 1$ to count overlapping strokes.
**Height Pass:** Draw each stroke white and textured with the height map paired with the opacity map.
Each pixel $p_i$ contains the grey value (height value) of the last stroke drawn at $p_i$.
*   **Stroke Orientation Approximation:** Bézier curves approximate, not interpolate, control points.
The curve may not pass through control points B and C but is pulled in their direction.
